nodes.label: Frozen Layer
nodes.rationale: Code that once shipped is excluded from the v1.0 build but kept rather than deleted so it can return, re-reviewed, if a client ever needs it.

nodes.label: Content-Addressed Storage
nodes.rationale: AttachmentContentStore keys bytes by SHA-256 with a reference count so identical attachments share one stored copy and deleting one leaves the other intact.

nodes.label: Read Model
nodes.rationale: Computed fresh from stored records when a screen asks and discarded after, never written down as a fact, so it cannot go stale the way a stored count could.

nodes.label: Invariant
nodes.rationale: Five platform rules each enforced by a test that fails the build, rather than a sentence nobody re-checks.

nodes.label: Honest Rail
nodes.rationale: The rail shows only destinations that genuinely work; five unbuilt modules were removed outright rather than dimmed.

nodes.label: Markdown Budget
nodes.rationale: A pull request may not add more lines of Markdown than code so process can never again outweigh the product it protects.

nodes.label: Seam
nodes.rationale: A single point every path to an outcome must pass through so a rule enforced there cannot be bypassed by an undiscovered second route.

nodes.label: Kill Switch
nodes.rationale: Stop and report rather than improvise if a goal cannot be met without touching a file outside the assigned list.

nodes.label: Timesheet Entry
nodes.rationale: Rates are resolved and frozen at the moment of recording so a later rate-card change never rewrites a past period.

nodes.label: ManualTask
nodes.rationale: Deliberately not named Task because that word was already claimed.

nodes.label: Warning-as-Error
nodes.rationale: A warning ignored today is a defect tomorrow.

nodes.label: Subject as a Tag
nodes.rationale: Held as a bare id never checked as a structural link so the object tree stays one strict hierarchy rather than a web.
